venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 7/28 (MOD Mkz/JK, entered by Mya).** Happy Bingo Tuesday! Opener had a busy start — a reservation of 12 and an Intuit happy hour filled the space. Bingo started promptly after the 6pm closer arrived; lots of returning faces and high energy — everyone loves Jess and was excited for the grand prize. Barback handled weekend prep; opener used downtime for housekeeping; made room in the cooler for Red Bull. Calm, consistent night; very busy day in the kitchen with everything coming out great. Kitchen: tickets out smoothly, prepare for big push on meal deals. 86: coleslaw. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: everyone so excited for Bingo.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 7/28 (MOD MD / Chef JMS, entered by BC).** Solid Tuesday. Guidepoint Security event ($1,000) went well and they left happy, with decent volume outside the event. Lots of new faces at bingo, many saying they'd return; a group of 8 arrived at 9:15pm to play. Pace slowed 8–9:15pm then steady waves until close, ending with industry groups from Pelato and Optimist plus two birthday groups. Comps $47.20 / 2.6% (bingo credits, Neuhoff residents/employees, manager, industry). Kitchen: John Michael held it down and checked on the bar frequently. Low: NA beer. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 7/28 (AM Maggie S/Carey, PM Maggie H).** First day on Toast! AM did $1,081.56 — customers stoked about tap-to-pay, cold brew strained and ready. PM did $6,180.65; whole team learning the new system and improving service change by change. Comps $468.88 plus $536.50 voids (Toast transition). Guests ~168 PM / ~95 AM (Toast counts). Kitchen: great night with Danté and Marv; decent prep list tomorrow. Low: olives, honey butter, tomato water, burger grind, lamb, flanks. 86: creamed spinach, walnut pesto, red pepper gel, ranch, lime chantilly, lime crumble. Maintenance: tile popped out in front of Marquee service well. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: hanging with Toast Ben.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Flood watches, heavy humidity, late rain
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 7/28 (Kyler + Steves, entered by Marielle).** A poppin' Tuesday despite flood watches — slow open, then everyone came at once. Two heavy turns: 7:30 filled the room including standing room, another pop at 10:30 did the same. Rosalie was top seller with straight Fernet close behind — lots of industry in. A passing couple discovered this is the original D&C after only knowing the LA location. Heavier late rain kept foot traffic down; died out around midnight. Comps $214 (gifts and service recovery). Kitchen: 86 oysters. Menu count 18. Breakage: wine glass, SOF, water glass. No-shows (Brad Navin 2@6pm, Zac Ryan Cantor 3@7:30pm) both charged successfully.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 7/28 (MOD Mikey, Chef Vic).** Not the busiest night but solid overall — all Marquee ($3,781), no Standing Room or event sales. Lots of birthdays celebrated in house; heavy industry presence: Pete from Capri Club/Palomino (in with a date — favorite moment), Anthony and Alexi from Bar Sawa, Double Chicken Please owners, Kenneth (Joe's buddy), and Jermaine from downtown Pasadena. Bar filled around 10 and stayed mostly full through the night; accommodated everyone; easy close. Report lists guest count 88 / average order $92 (check avg computed at net/guests = $42.97). Comps $201 industry/birthdays/employee discounts. Kitchen: slower food night. No 86s, no incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 7/28 (MOD Marcus/Josh).** Brutally slow start — first table not seated until 5:45pm after a brief summer storm — then slow but steady the rest of the night. Marquee bar sales $3,356.58; net incl. events $3,047.38. Many solo diners and two-tops (76 guests: 56 walk-in / 20 reso), letting the team deliver attentive service. Michael B observed service and worked alongside the team; feedback to come. Team stayed engaged through light covers and used the pace for side work and organization. Comps $6.16 (investor). Kitchen: lighter night, high quality. Maintenance: curtains coming off rails; rechargeable stair lights not lasting full service (new ones ordered). No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: team keeping vibes high through the storms.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 7/28 (AM Sam; PM Justin & Marcus/Chef Drew).** Slow morning ($780, 30 guests) picking up near happy hour. Evening ($3,300, 97 guests) started with a bang — a walk-in group of ~20 ladies handled expertly by Carla Morgan while the bar hit 75% — then dragged after 7:30 with more bar than floor business. Sun Club just $6 despite nice weather; Skylar's final training shift with Samantha. Hot Eye $0. Kitchen: wasted 6 cans of tomatoes delivered in bad shape — rep sending replacements tomorrow plus credit; quart containers back tomorrow. No incidents. Favorite moments: Ezra's work on the Mezz, Skylar shaking with finesse, industry visits from Pinky's, Untitled, and Brochus.
